summary: Targem Games' top-down arcade vehicular-combat racer, focused on local multiplayer, powerups, drop-in play, and fast survival/race/King of the Hill modes across PC, PlayStation, VR, and Switch routes.

entries.title: BlazeRush

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows for the main route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC release at highest stable settings

primary.why: BlazeRush released on Windows and PlayStation 3 in 2014, later appearing across PlayStation 4, Linux, macOS, Oculus Rift, Oculus Go, and Nintendo Switch. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible route for local multiplayer and VR-capable PC play.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings; use Switch for portable multiplayer or VR builds only if you specifically want headset play.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster or complete edition.
